SELECT DISTINCT v.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack, p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, s.clause AS clause
FROM document AS d
JOIN disposition AS v ON v.target = d.id AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = ip.pack_id
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id
WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND d.number = 'R1-1913654' AND s.spec IN ('38.213', 'TS 38.213')

WITH pack_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number, s.spec, s.release, s.clause, p.tsg_number
    FROM document AS d
    JOIN disposition AS v ON v.target = d.id AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
    JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
    JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.cr = d.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = ip.pack_id
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id
    WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND p.pack_number = 'RP-192634' AND d.target_release IN ('Rel-16') AND s.release = d.target_release
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.number AS document, t.spec AS specification, t.clause AS clause
FROM pack_clauses AS t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM section AS es
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS em ON em.section_id = es.id
    JOIN document AS ed ON ed.id = em.cr AND ed.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND ed.target_release = t.release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ei ON ei.cr = ed.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS ep ON ep.id = ei.pack_id AND ep.tsg_number < t.tsg_number
    WHERE es.spec = t.spec AND es.release = t.release AND es.clause = t.clause
)

WITH pack_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number, s.spec, s.release, s.clause, p.tsg_number
    FROM document AS d
    JOIN disposition AS v ON v.target = d.id AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
    JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
    JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id AND m.wg = 'RAN1'
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.cr = d.id

    WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND p.pack_number = 'RP-200692' AND d.target_release IN ('Rel-16') AND s.release = d.target_release
), earlier_packs AS (
    SELECT t.spec, t.release, t.clause, ep.pack_number, ep.tsg_meeting,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.spec, t.release, t.clause, t.tsg_number ORDER BY ep.tsg_number DESC) AS precedence
    FROM pack_clauses AS t
    JOIN section AS es ON es.spec = t.spec AND es.release = t.release AND es.clause = t.clause
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS em ON em.section_id = es.id
    JOIN document AS ed ON ed.id = em.cr AND ed.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR' AND ed.target_release = t.release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ei ON ei.cr = ed.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS ep ON ep.id = ei.pack_id AND ep.tsg_number < t.tsg_number
)
